title: DippyMcSkippy SMP
description: The modpack for the DippyMcSkippy SMP
body:
This Modpack was put together by DippyMcSkippy for his SMP server.

This includes a lot of "vanilla plus" mods that imporve base minecraft withou chnaging too much. It also includes some other fun stuff for a better multiplayer experience.

There are some textures made by Dippy that are not required but I think are quite fun.

Credits:
Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/

Red Sand Recolored: [https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/red-sand-recolored/](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/red-sand-recolored/)
